providers.subtitle: Each provider is configured by pasting an API key here. The api stores it in a chmod-0600 file on the host and passes it to every omp session as an env var.
providers.envReloadNote: The api reads the keystore on every omp session spawn, so a new key is picked up by your next prompt — no process restart required.
